Hey all, before we drag the full dept heads into the PPM for the Gingham rollout I want us six in a room to get our ducks in a row. Rough idea of what we're working through:

- Who owns which block on the one-liner, since the strip board's still shifting with the location swap
* Whether we lock the DOOD now or hold until the cast deal memos come back
- What the PPM actually needs to land on: shot list sign-off vs. a full tech scout recap
  - Cyrus / Hana: where you're at on the lighting package + grip truck, roughly
* Ines: ballpark on the extras count and whether it pushes us into a second holding area
-Gemma, any flags from the 2nd AD side on turnaround or company moves

Honestly not sure yet how much of this needs the whole crew vs. us sorting it out first, which is kind of the point. If we go into the PPM with open questions on schedule and budget it'll eat three hours and the dept heads will walk.

Bring your latest versions of whatever you've got (cross-plots, call sheet drafts, budget top sheet). No deck needed.
